title: Spell Shop Still Life
description: A wooden market table displays magical wares in front of a blue Spell Shop facade. Visible items include a large glass jar containing a blue-tinted woman's face, multiple scrolls labeled 'Profile Bindings' and 'Still Visions', illustrated books and cards with the same woman's portrait, a lit blue candle, scattered parchment notes, and three circular tokens on a metal plate.
prompt: A detailed still life on a rustic wooden table outside a blue wooden Spell Shop with a hanging sign that reads 'SPELL SHOP - PROFILE BINDINGS & STILL VISIONS'. On the table sits a large glass apothecary jar filled with blue liquid containing a floating woman's face, several rolled scrolls tied with string labeled 'Profile Bindings' and 'Still Visions', illustrated books and cards showing the same woman's serene face in blue tones, a lit blue candle, scattered parchment notes, and three white circular tokens on a brass plate. The scene has an old, stained white cloth with blue patterns draped over the table, creating a mysterious magical atmosphere.
